context: Two managers review a failed partnership and losses
purpose: Teach: 集会/拡張/名称/同盟/関与/提携/損失/連中

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 昨日の臨時集会で、A社との提携を正式に解消することが決まったよ。
lines.en: At yesterday's emergency meeting, it was decided we'd officially end our partnership with Company A.
lines.style: Heavy, resigned delivery with a slow downward cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: やっぱりですか…事業拡張の話が出た時点で、嫌な予感はしてたんですよね。
lines.en: I knew it... I had a bad feeling the moment the business expansion talks came up.
lines.style: Quiet sigh, slightly bitter but composed female voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同盟みたいな関係って言ってたくせに、向こうの連中、肝心なところで何も動かなかった。
lines.en: They called it an alliance, but those guys didn't lift a finger when it mattered most.
lines.style: Frustrated, lowered voice with sharp consonants on key words.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 結局、こちらの損失だけが膨らんで、契約上の名称も曖昧なまま放置されてましたしね。
lines.en: In the end, only our losses kept growing, and even the contract's official designation was left vague.
lines.style: Measured analytical tone, mild exasperation underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 上層部が深く関与してたのに、責任の所在を最後まで誰もはっきりさせなかったのが痛い。
lines.en: Upper management was deeply involved, yet no one ever clarified who was responsible — that's what stings.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate, with weight on each clause.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 来週、社内で報告会があるそうですが、私たちはどこまで話せばいいんでしょうか。
lines.en: Apparently there's an internal briefing next week — how much are we supposed to disclose?
lines.style: Cautious tone with a slightly anxious upward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 事実だけ淡々と。感情を挟むと、また面倒な連中が騒ぎ出すからな。
lines.en: Just the facts, dryly. If we let emotion in, those troublemakers will start kicking up a fuss again.
lines.style: Low, world-weary, almost a warning, distinct timbre that anchors the scene

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。次の提携先は、もう少し慎重に選びましょう。
lines.en: Understood. Let's be a bit more careful when choosing our next partner.
lines.style: Steady, professional, quietly determined closing line.
